name: Sliding-rivet pauldron: hubless nested plates with follower-in-slot joints
verdict: dead: best gap 177.0 vs the 3R baseline 68.93; the sliding band's tail (constant radius, ~80 deg of excess travel stored past b) runs into the neck / arm in 20-40 % of poses; trimming the J2 range, moving the J2 rollers onto an L1 arm toward W, post-mounted band and ring tracks did not remove it - not worth a GPU sweep
limiter: the L2 band's tail: a band that slides through followers at b keeps one radius about GH and stores the ~80 deg change of the b-W angle (phig 40-120 deg over the fit clips) past b, over the trapezius into the neck (and into the arm in elevated poses): per-pose band requirement p50 99 mm, p80 >= 150 mm (local-outer skin radius) vs 43-60 mm skin under its b-W part; worst poses = elevation 120-135 deg (phig 61-69), band azimuth >= 96 deg inside the body to 150 mm; contact 0.41 of taken poses at best
